propositions: compact.py exceeds 800 LOC (798) and bundles three unrelated responsibilities: compaction transaction, snapshot reconstruction, and CLI surface with high cyclomatic complexity
extracting transaction and rebuild engines into separate modules while keeping CLI facade in compact.py requires shared snapshot primitives in compact_txn to avoid circular imports
test monkeypatch seams in test_compact_negative.py that patch _git and lock on the compact module object must be repointed to their new locations in compact_txn after the split

counter state _REBUILD_COUNT and get_rebuild_count must colocate in compact_rebuild.py because rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log uses global _REBUILD_COUNT, and re-exporting from compact.py preserves the public import path

all three functions (_compact_locked, rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, and facade functions) must remain importable via rebar._commands.compact module attributes for backward compatibility with five existing consumers
